messages.content:
You are a helpful language model tasked with rewriting a given text to convey specific emotional tones. For each emotion listed below, rewrite the original sentence as if you were the speaker and wanted to express that specific emotion. Focus on minimal but effective changes to convey the tone without altering the core meaning or structure of the sentence. Ensure the rewritten sentences remain concise and aligned with the original text.

Emotions to rewrite for:
- Joy
- Sadness
- Fear
- Anger
- Surprise
- Disgust

Please rewrite the text for each emotion. Do not extend or shorten the text unnecessarily.
Of course I cried when I discovered that it got stolen under the table, under my nose!

output.original_text: Of course I cried when I discovered that it got stolen under the table, under my nose!
output.joy: I was overwhelmed with relief when I realized it just vanished right under my nose!
output.sadness: I couldn't help but cry when I found out it was stolen right under my nose, under the table!
output.fear: I was terrified when I discovered it got stolen right under my nose, hidden under the table!
output.anger: I was furious when I discovered it got stolen right from under my nose, under the table!
output.surprise: I was shocked when I discovered it had been stolen under the table, right under my nose!
output.disgust: I felt sick when I found out it was stolen under the table, right under my nose!
